Name: (CP) Elliott in Shipping Bin
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
With this mod, Elliott will cozy up in your shipping bin. For writing purposes, surely. Not to drink into your wine profits. It's for feeding the muse!
(note: doesn't actually affect your wine profits. [s]Yet.[/s])

~~

Requested by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/127392318]VoronFall![/url]

Inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/65]JG Demetrius in Shipping Box mod[/url], this mod adds Elliott into your shipping bin. When you ship an item, he'll pop out and back inside. Purely cosmetic and for fun; rest assured that your products and profits are entirely safe.

Works with buildable shipping bins around the farm, and overlays over other shipping bin colors--like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1554]Eemie's Dark Wood[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1904]my Burnt Sienna[/url]~

Note however that this mod does [b]not [/b]work with anything that affects the shipping bin animation itself--such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url]. 


[b]To install--[/b]
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. Load up your game and enjoy--ELLIOTT [b]NO[/b]
